business_problem: Squary AI needed to eliminate slow, outage-prone legal search infrastructure that combined MongoDB with OpenSearch and hurt document review speed, cost, and trust.
solution_summary: Squary AI consolidated its legal-workflow platform onto MongoDB Atlas by moving text search and vector search off a separate OpenSearch deployment and into MongoDB Search and MongoDB Vector Search on Atlas. The platform stores case documents in Atlas, indexes existing collections directly without schema rewrites, and used a short dual-write period to validate the migration before cutover. MongoDB Search provides full-text relevance while MongoDB Vector Search supplies embedding-based retrieval for hybrid search. Those retrieval layers feed retrieval-augmented generation workflows that use Claude or Amazon Bedrock depending on client sensitivity. The platform also attaches citations to every generated claim so attorneys can verify outputs against page-level evidence inside very large document sets. By unifying JSON data, search, vectors, and observability on one platform, Squary AI replaced a fragile multi-system stack with a simpler architecture that scales proactively and keeps legal teams working.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores Squary AI's legal data and now unifies the operational database, text search, and vector search on one platform.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Search
solution_components.role: Provides full-text similarity search across legal document collections for hybrid retrieval.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Vector Search on Atlas
solution_components.role: Retrieves semantically similar passages and supports citation-backed RAG over large legal document sets.

solution_components.name: Claude
solution_components.role: Generates legal outputs from retrieved evidence for clients whose data can use that model path.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Provides an alternate LLM execution path for client data that requires that deployment model.

data_flow: Legal documents live in MongoDB Atlas, where MongoDB Search and MongoDB Vector Search on Atlas index the same collections for hybrid retrieval; relevant passages are sent to Claude or Amazon Bedrock-backed generation, and the application returns source-linked answers with page-level citations attorneys can verify.
business_outcome: Squary AI now handles 10x more data for less cost, returns search and generation results in single-digit seconds, has seen zero outages since migration, and cut document review time by up to 70%.
